quest.title: Go to the Institute of Clockwork Applications and retrieve the Anchor
quest.description: You arrived at the new Fontaine Research Institute and met with co-administrators Raimondo and Choiseul. After a long, mind-numbing conversation, you were tasked to escort Nacker and retrieve the last two Anchors.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

talks.objective: Go to the Institute of Clockwork Applications
Enter the Institute of Clockwork Applications

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: #There should be a Survey Anchor here too. I'll open the door, and leave the recovery to you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Chronie
dialogues.text: Yeah... I still can't forget how Choiseul just kept equivocating.

dialogues.speaker: Chronie
dialogues.text: And that Raimondo... So haughty and arrogant. Did you see how he was looking at me?

dialogues.speaker: Chronie
dialogues.text: I think you're much better than either of those two. Things would have never turned out like that if you were in their position.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: I believe this place was originally Butor's "Institute of Clockwork Applications." In the field of clockwork machines, Monsieur Butor was one of the leading authorities.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: However, scientifically, the development and advancement of traditional clockwork machines had reached a bottleneck. In terms of applications, traditional clockwork machines were obviously at a great disadvantage.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Anyway, Monsieur Butor's program was slowly being marginalized at the Institute. His funding was cut, and he struggled to recruit researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: After a series of unfortunate incidents, Monsieur Butor's group finally disbanded, and this facility was completely abandoned.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: *sigh* Monsieur Butor was terribly unlucky, if you ask me...
